story: Gary has wandered off to Magnolia Loop while Donna, Hal, and Rosa stay behind at Gary's house on this mild Wednesday evening. Donna cheerfully reports that she has trimmed her flamingos down to three, which should keep Hal's violation notice in the drawer, and Rosa is busy lining up a Saturday dinner at six. Hal, dutifully, is inspecting Gary's golf cart for any modifications visible from the street, while Rosa scans the neighborhood for Gary so she can deliver the invitation.
events: Gary headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Hal (gary golf cart): Walk around the cart and note which modifications are visible from the street for L-01

gary.thought_process: I filed the Architectural Review form for the cart and signed up for the parade, so the paperwork side is done. Nobody's around in the square and it's evening, so there's no one to talk to. The best use of the hour is to get back to Magnolia Loop and the garage, since the lights and sound system won't wire themselves. I'll keep the sound system off after 10 PM and finish before my pickleball morning with Donna.

parameters.content: Heading home to the garage to start wiring the lights and sound system on the cart, now that the form is filed and the parade signup is done.

donna.thought_process: I'm at Gary's house with Hal and Rosa, it's evening, and Rosa has already pinned down Saturday dinner at six. Gary and I have our plan for pickleball at eight, so I don't need to re-invite him. I just pulled my extra flamingos down to three, which settles Hal's complaint, so now's a good moment to mention it in a friendly way and keep the peace. Gary isn't visible in line-of-sight, so I'll speak to Hal, close the flamingo matter, and keep the evening light and social.

parameters.content: Evening, Hal. I trimmed the flamingos down to three this afternoon, so you can put the violation notice away. Rosa's got us all lined up for Saturday dinner, and I'm bringing dessert.

hal.thought_process: I'm at Gary's house to inspect the cart, and the man isn't here. Rosa already got my message, and I've said my piece about Saturday at six. Repeating it to her would be pointless. The cart is sitting right there, and my last logged action was the inspection, so I should finish the job properly and note what's visible from the street. I'll judge it by the book and be fair about it, not by how annoyed I am about the parade. Fair means looking at the facts before I file anything.

parameters.content: Walk around the cart and note which modifications are visible from the street for L-01

rosa.thought_process: I'm at Gary's house looking for him, and he isn't here. Hal already knows about Saturday at six. Donna just arrived and has already said yes to dinner, but I haven't confirmed the time with her in these memories. Asking Hal again would be repeating myself, so I should turn to Donna, give her the time, and ask if she's seen Gary. That moves the dinner plan forward and gets all four of us accounted for.

parameters.content: Donna, good timing. Dinner's Saturday at six at my place, and I'm still hunting for Gary to tell him. You seen him anywhere?

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
